$comment: Manifest row for the `ever-works/missions` catalog (added 2026-09-17 — EXT-13). Add this object to the catalog's manifest.json. The catalog's own schema requires slug, title, type, summary and schedule; it rejects `version`, `defaults`, `kb`, `appWork` and `suggestedGoals`, which is why the runtime manifest stays in the standalone seed repository `ever-works/build-on-open-source-app-mission-template` and this row only describes the listing.
title: Build on an open-source app
summary: Build my own product for my business on top of an open-source app I already run: every Monday it files up to two small, budgeted, approval-gated changes on an App Work and follows each one until it is live.

suggestedAgentTemplates.reason: Prepares the app and can change it; the Mission's Tasks run on an Agent that may commit.
